title: Monicity, positive degree and coefficient naturality of cyclotomic polynomials
statement: Let $N\geq1$ be an integer. For each nonzero commutative ring $R$, let $\Phi_{N,R}\in R[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] be the image of the integer cyclotomic polynomial $\Phi_N\in\mathbf Z[T]$, the monic family characterized by $T^n-1=\prod_{d\mid n}\Phi_d(T)$ for $n\geq1$. Then $\Phi_{N,R}$ is monic (its leading coefficient is $1$) and $\deg\Phi_{N,R}>0$. For every homomorphism $u:R\to S$ to a commutative ring $S$, applying $u$ to the coefficients gives $u_*(\Phi_{N,R})=\Phi_{N,S}$.
